title: NEW PC Airports! | TJSJ San Juan & EHKD Den Helder | MSFS Update
description:
In the Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update for April 23, 2026, this week brings a great mix of locations for PC pilots including the must‑have Photorico San Juan International that’s perfect for both GA and airliner fans looking for high-quality island scenery! 😄

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Photorico Scenery: TJSJ San Juan International Airport (Highly detailed Caribbean hub)
🛫 simpixel: EHKD Den Helder Airport (Dutch coastal airport with great atmosphere)
🛫 GUDISIM: WIBD PINANG KAMPAI (Perfect for exploring Southeast Asia)
